verdict.rationale: Vast.ai's docs and CLI clearly support searching/filtering the marketplace by GPU model (e.g., `gpu_name=RTX_4090`) and offer tiered pricing (on-demand, reserved, interruptible) that would let an ML engineer pick pricier or cheaper GPU options, and 'Secure Cloud (Datacenter)' verification implies access to datacenter-grade hardware. However, none of the evidence explicitly confirms availability of current-generation H100/H200/B200-class GPUs alongside older cards — all concrete examples in the pack use RTX_4090 (a consumer card), not datacenter-tier flagship GPUs. Missing for 10: explicit documentation or listing showing H100/H200/B200 GPUs are actually rentable on the platform alongside cheaper previous-gen options.
